name: Unone AI-native Audit
description: Evidence-backed AI-native scoring with in-memory report evaluation, versioned local assessment history and freshness checks. Start with ai_native.recommend. Read-only by default; registration requires explicit host write opt-in. Not signed or commercial certification.

tools.name: ai_native.recommend
tools.description: Stage 1: describe your audit goal. Return at most five relevant operation summaries, availability and reasons; no full schemas or execution.

tools.name: ai_native.describe
tools.description: Stage 2: retrieve one selected operation's exact schema, examples, errors, limitations and version-bound contractHash.

tools.name: ai_native.call
tools.description: Invoke a selected contract; register is an explicit append-only write requiring host opt-in, other operations are read-only. Never execute evidence commands. Reject stale hashes.

tools.name: plugin.test
tools.description: Run dependency-free rubric/discovery smoke invariants; does not certify the target or execute probes.
